_: The apps the SideStore source lists (ci/sidestore_source.py): each from this repository's releases tagged <tag>-<n> that carry an .ipa asset. Terra's ipa job, adrift.yml and toys.yml each regenerate the source from here (an app with no release yet is left out).

apps.name: Terra Incognita
apps.subtitle: The world, closer and closer
apps.localizedDescription: A wandering atlas in the making: a live globe, its ground, sea and clouds as satellites and buoys saw them, and a workbench of prototypes to try on it. Offline, apart from the workbench's optional prototype packs.

apps.name: Adrift
apps.subtitle: Glass floats on the real sea
apps.localizedDescription: Tap the open sea and it rings; rest a beat longer and a glass float is yours, lamp amber on a cool sea. The month's real currents and winds, measured by drifting buoys, carry it; nothing scripts where it goes. Written from scratch in Rust on the GPU. Offline; every dataset credited.

apps.name: Whales
apps.subtitle: Two whales, their songs and their travels
apps.localizedDescription: Pick two whales and hear them sing as they travel the real oceans. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Murmuration
apps.subtitle: A flock, and you one of them
apps.localizedDescription: Hundreds of birds on simple rules over the real sky; lean and the flock bends around you. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Mold
apps.subtitle: A slime mold finds the night's cities
apps.localizedDescription: A glowing mold on the night Earth seeks the cities' lights and finds the routes between them. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Fireflies
apps.subtitle: Every night city a firefly
apps.localizedDescription: Each city of the night Earth blinks its own rhythm; nudge one and continents fall into step. Working title; a toy in the making.
